exams.name: NGWA Certified Pump Installer
exams.blurb: Voluntary national certification for contractors installing and servicing water well pumps, pitless units and pressure systems.

exams.name: NGWA Certified Well Driller
exams.blurb: Voluntary national certification examining drilling methods, well construction standards, grouting and groundwater protection.

exams.name: NGWA Master Ground Water Contractor
exams.blurb: Advanced NGWA credential requiring both drilling and pump installation certification plus extensive documented field experience.

exams.name: Certified Crop Adviser
exams.blurb: North American certification requiring international and local board exams in nutrient, soil, pest and water management.

exams.name: Certified Crop Adviser 4R Nutrient Management Specialty
exams.blurb: Specialty credential for Certified Crop Advisers demonstrating expertise in right source, rate, time and place nutrient stewardship.

exams.name: Certified Professional Agronomist
exams.blurb: Certification for degreed agronomists covering crop production, soil fertility, pest management and environmental stewardship.

exams.name: Underground Storage Tank Class A Operator Certification
exams.body: State UST Programs under U.S. EPA Energy Policy Act Rules
exams.blurb: Certification for operators with primary responsibility for underground storage tank regulatory compliance and system operation.

exams.name: Underground Storage Tank Class B Operator Certification
exams.body: State UST Programs under U.S. EPA Energy Policy Act Rules
exams.blurb: Certification for operators who implement day-to-day release detection, spill prevention and recordkeeping at UST facilities.

exams.name: Underground Storage Tank Class C Operator Training
exams.body: State UST Programs under U.S. EPA Energy Policy Act Rules
exams.blurb: Site-level training for staff who respond first to alarms, spills and emergencies at fuelling facilities with underground storage tanks.

exams.name: NAWT Onsite Wastewater Inspector Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for inspectors evaluating septic tanks, drainfields and other onsite wastewater systems at property transfer.

exams.name: NAWT Onsite Wastewater Installer Certification
exams.blurb: Certification covering site evaluation, tank setting, drainfield construction and start-up of onsite wastewater treatment systems.

exams.name: Associate Fisheries Professional
exams.blurb: Entry-level certification for fisheries graduates who meet academic requirements but have not yet accrued professional experience.

exams.name: Certified Fisheries Professional
exams.blurb: Professional certification recognising fisheries scientists who meet coursework and experience standards in fisheries management.

exams.name: Associate Wildlife Biologist
exams.blurb: Entry-level certification for wildlife graduates meeting coursework requirements before accruing the experience needed for CWB.

exams.name: Certified Wildlife Biologist
exams.blurb: Peer-reviewed certification confirming academic coursework and at least five years of professional wildlife biology experience.

exams.name: Registered Environmental Manager
exams.blurb: Registry credential for managers of environmental compliance programmes covering air, water, waste and remediation regulations.

exams.name: Registered Environmental Professional
exams.blurb: Broad registry credential recognising practitioners working across environmental science, compliance and site assessment fields.

exams.name: IICRC Applied Microbial Remediation Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Certification covering containment, engineering controls and cleaning methods used in mould and sewage remediation projects.

exams.name: IICRC Water Damage Restoration Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Certification covering water intrusion categories, psychrometry and structural drying procedures used in restoration work.

exams.name: NORMI Certified Mold Assessor
exams.body: National Organization of Remediators and Mold Inspectors (NORMI)
exams.blurb: Certification for inspectors who assess moisture and microbial growth in buildings and prepare independent remediation protocols.

exams.name: NORMI Certified Mold Remediator
exams.body: National Organization of Remediators and Mold Inspectors (NORMI)
exams.blurb: Certification for contractors performing mould remediation with containment, negative air and post-remediation verification steps.

exams.name: NRSB Radon Measurement Specialist
exams.blurb: Alternative EPA-recognised credential for individuals performing residential and commercial radon measurement services.

exams.name: NRSB Radon Mitigation Specialist
exams.blurb: Alternative EPA-recognised credential for individuals designing and installing radon reduction systems in existing buildings.

exams.name: ABPA Backflow Prevention Assembly Tester Certification
exams.blurb: Alternative tester certification recognised by many water purveyors for annual testing of backflow prevention assemblies.

exams.name: Certified Erosion and Sediment Control Lead
exams.blurb: Construction stormwater certification for site leads who inspect erosion controls and sample discharges under general permits.

exams.name: Certified Water Technologist
exams.blurb: Certification for industrial water treatment professionals covering boilers, cooling towers, corrosion control and Legionella risk.

exams.name: Certified Ecologist
exams.blurb: Peer-reviewed professional certification recognising education and experience in applied and academic ecological practice.

exams.name: Certified Environmental Professional
exams.body: Academy of Board Certified Environmental Professionals (ABCEP)
exams.blurb: Board certification recognising senior practitioners in environmental assessment, planning, documentation and management.

exams.name: Certified Forester
exams.blurb: National credential requiring a forestry degree, qualifying experience and an examination on silviculture, measurement and management.

exams.name: Certified Professional in Rangeland Management
exams.blurb: Certification for rangeland professionals covering ecological site inventory, grazing management and rangeland improvement practice.

exams.name: Certified Professional Soil Scientist
exams.blurb: Certification requiring the Fundamentals of Soil Science exam plus professional practice experience in soil classification and use.

exams.name: Professional Wetland Scientist
exams.body: Society of Wetland Scientists Professional Certification Program
exams.blurb: Certification for wetland delineators and scientists documenting education and experience in hydrology, soils and wetland vegetation.

exams.name: Aboveground Storage Tank Operator Training
exams.body: State Environmental Agencies under U.S. EPA SPCC Rule
exams.blurb: Training on inspection, spill prevention and recordkeeping duties for personnel responsible for aboveground petroleum storage tanks.

exams.name: NIOSH 582 Equivalency Asbestos Air Sampling Course
aka: Sampling and Evaluating Airborne Asbestos Dust
exams.blurb: Course qualifying technicians to collect and analyse airborne asbestos fibre samples using NIOSH 7400 phase-contrast microscopy methods.

exams.name: Phase I Environmental Site Assessment Environmental Professional Training
exams.blurb: Training on All Appropriate Inquiries and ASTM E1527 practice for professionals conducting Phase I environmental site assessments.
